title: Higher-Dimensional Quantum Cellular Automata beyond Translations
exact_target: Classify higher-dimensional cellular automata beyond finite-depth circuits, lattice shifts and the currently known examples.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006638 (OWR-14299913-008). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Classification must keep the spatial dimension, stabilization and equivalence relation specified in the source; a one-dimensional index classification does not answer the higher-dimensional problem.
